name: Gilfaethwy

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gilfaethwy is a violent Welsh hero. He is the brother of Gwydion and the son of the mother goddess Dôn. He desired Goewin, the virgin who served his uncle King Math as ceremonial footholder. Goewin refused him. Gilfaethwy ignored her and raped her. As punishment he was turned into a deer, then a pig, and then a wolf.

okr.objective: Document the Welsh hero Gilfaethwy and his punishment for rape.
